# RuntimeError <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
RuntimeError:Void message:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | In | String | required | The text that describes what went wrong. |

## Description

Shows an error message and ends the program with a non-zero exit code. Use it for problems your program cannot recover from.

## Differences

* The message is printed as `Runtime Error: ...` on the standard error output, not shown in a dialog box.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
If FileType("level.dat") = 0 Then RuntimeError "level.dat is missing"
```
